title: CAPI module.yml: common base
description: What every module.yml carries, whatever its type. Not used on its own: a module.yml references the <type>.module.schema.v1.json for its type, which extends this one. Generated from capi/module.yml's catalogs -- do not hand-edit, run generate_module_schema.py instead.

version.description: This module's own version, X.Y.Z. Every module.yml must have one.

capi_version_requirement.description: The capi version this module is written against, as a version constraint: one of >=, <=, =, > or < followed by X.Y.Z, so ">=1.0.0" or "=1.0.0" to pin one version, or a range like ">1.0.1,<1.2.3". It names which capi, not whether capi is needed, so it is never a boolean or a bare version.

repo_refs.description: Repositories named once, referenced by name from depends entries (repo:).

constraint.description: A version constraint: (>=|<=|=|>|<)X.Y.Z, or a range (>|>=)X.Y.Z,(<|<=)X.Y.Z such as >1.0.1,<1.2.3.

name.description: A name, not a location: not '.', and no '/', '\', '..', '"', ';' or whitespace. Locations go in path:.

checkout.description: A branch, tag or commit, whatever git checkout accepts. If a name could mean more than one thing, git's own rules decide. Never starts with '-', which git would read as an option, and never contains whitespace, '"' or ';'.

version.description: Constraint on the package's own module.yml version.

path.description: Where the package is, or, with git:, where it is cloned. //<dir> is relative to CAPI_WORKSPACE, any other path to this module.yml's directory. The resolver refuses a path that leaves whichever of the two it is relative to, so reach a package outside this module with //<dir>, not with '..'. Never absolute (no leading '/', drive letter or backslash), and never contains '"', ';' or a newline.

git.description: Repository URL, if it can be fetched.

checkout.description: What to check out after cloning; needs git:.

subdir.description: Location of the package inside its repository; relative, without '..', and never contains '"', ';' or a newline.

repo.description: Name of an entry in this module's repo_refs:.
repo: names an entry in this module's repo_refs:, which already carries the git URL and what to check out. Set git: and checkout: there, not here.

subdir.description: subdir: locates the package inside a repository, so it needs one: either git: or repo:.

interfaces.description: Interfaces this module REQUIRES. Every declared target must provide them.

platform.description: Keyed by the preset's PLATFORM value; one entry is chosen per build. The package is capi-<key>.

interfaces.description: Required by the modules built from this one, not by it.

toolchain.description: A CMake toolchain file, relative to this module.yml's directory and ending in .cmake. It becomes CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE, set before project() runs, so it is what selects the compiler.

vendor_sdk.description: A CMake file that wires up the vendor SDK (MSDK, STM32Cube, ...), relative to this module.yml's directory and ending in .cmake. It must define capi_<platform>_config_sdk(TARGET): capi_create_application() include()s the file and then calls that function.

kconfig.description: The Kconfig symbol that builds this driver. Its depends.interfaces apply to a target only where it is enabled.

no_provides.description: Provides no interfaces: each module a collection holds has its own module.yml, which is where it says what it provides.

boards.description: The boards this app has presets for, and the targets its interfaces are checked on.

items.description: A directory relative to this module.yml, without '..'.

modules.description: The directories of the modules this collection holds, relative to this module.yml and without '..'. Each has its own module.yml.

board_role.description: host: a board carrying the MCU a build targets, boards/<board>/ in a platform package, or one core of it. addon: a board that plugs into a host board through one of its connectors.
